title: Canonical scalar cokernel classes and specialization invariance
statement: Let T be a commutative totally disconnected topological ring, X and Y schemes and p:Y→X. Canonically realize p^*p_X^*C(-,T) as continuous T-valued functions. For a map g between finite free modules define its continuous matrix by biproduct inclusions/projections and evaluation of regular endomorphisms at 1. Define its fibre type at y as the isomorphism class of T^n/image(g(y)) in the skeleton of ModuleCat T. If T is Hausdorff, this type agrees at any specialization v ⤳ w in Y.

source.place: Example 3.1; parent comparison proof steps 2--5; for local Smith, Theorem 6.12(2) pivot/division argument.

proof.text: Compose the canonical coefficient pullback comparison with the continuous-ring realization. Conjugate regular endomorphisms along this ring isomorphism and evaluate their action on the unit section; this gives continuous functions. Take finite biproduct matrix entries and the ordinary scalar quotient, then its isomorphism class.

A continuous function to a Hausdorff space takes equal values at comparable points. Apply this to each entry; the two scalar matrices are equal, and hence their quotient objects and their skeleton classes are equal.

Local constancy of the skeleton class gives an open neighborhood on which all scalar cokernels have equal skeleton representatives. Equality in the skeleton gives a module-category isomorphism, hence the required scalar linear equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof of the corresponding part of lem-sfb-integral-lfp-constant-model-comparison; explicit universe-polymorphic coefficient construction.

theorem presentationFiberType_specializes (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [TopologicalSpace T]
    [IsTopologicalRing T] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace T] [T2Space T]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) {m n : ℕ}
    (g : Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj
      (baseCoeff T X)) m ⟶
      Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj
      (baseCoeff T X)) n)
    {v w : Y} (h : v ⤳ w) :
    presentationFiberType T f g v = presentationFiberType T f g w
